scientific_integrity: Full theorem proof via three-orbit spectral decomposition and reciprocal-spectrum weak majorization; exact rational finite checks are supporting evidence only; same-model review, no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The result covers exactly two perfectly grounded leaders on unit-weight complete split graphs with both classes of size at least two and all real inverse spectral orders r>=1; it does not cover other budgets, weighted edges, finite leader gains, or orders below one. Potential unindexed equivalents remain.
title: Spectral-order rigidity and a unique fractional-order leader switch on complete split networks
